PlayerInputModeService.luau.description: Validates input-mode reports from each client and exposes the result through a replicated Player attribute. Public entry points include `PlayerInputModeService.Init`, `PlayerInputModeService.Start`, `PlayerInputModeService.GetPlayerInputModeType`, `PlayerInputModeService.GetPlayerInputModeAsync`, `PlayerInputModeService.ObservePlayerInputType`, `PlayerInputModeService.Destroy`.
